Nothing saved yet. Dial in a groove you like and save it here.

Export a loop

Saves a .zip with an MP3, a WAV and a General MIDI drum file of the current groove, mixed exactly as you hear it. The WAV loops without a gap. MP3 players can add a tiny gap at the loop point.

Drums are real recordings: Big Rusty Drums by Karoryfer Samples (CC0), a big 1980s Szpaderski kit (24-inch kick, 14-inch snare, 14 and 18-inch toms) with Sabian hi-hat and ride, recorded with close and overhead mics. Tambourine and shaker come from the VSCO 2 community library (CC0). Every hit picks from several velocity layers and alternate strikes, and the timing drifts a few milliseconds like a human player. Each style uses the kit's own mic balance with light, style-matched compression and EQ.
